rangeHighlighting_help.message: Enable Modern highlighting for more stable highlighting on most modern websites, such as LinkedIn, YouTube and Salesforce. It highlights text without changing the page structure, helping prevent duplicated text and leftover highlights as pages update. Text colors, background colors and underline remain available. Bold, italic, borders, rounded corners and padding are unavailable in this mode; your saved styles are kept if you switch back. Older browsers without support use the standard method. Save this setting, then reload open pages.

range_update_description.message: Enable our new highlighting engine for more stable highlighting on most modern websites, such as LinkedIn, YouTube and Salesforce. It highlights text without changing the page structure, helping prevent duplicated text and leftover highlights as pages update. We recommend enabling Modern highlighting for smoother everyday browsing. Text colors, background colors and underline remain available. Bold, italic, borders, rounded corners and padding aren’t supported in this mode. Your saved styles are kept if you switch back. Enable Modern highlighting in General settings, save, then reload your open pages.
